verdict.summary: The video streaming app's AI-powered recommendation system requires improvements to meet Indian data protection and user consent requirements.

issues.title: Missing Explicit Consent
issues.description: The current implementation does not require explicit consent from users for collecting and using their watch history, which is a violation of Article 7 of the Personal Data Protection Bill, 2019.
issues.impact: Potential GDPR-like fines under Indian law
issues.remediation: Implement an opt-in mechanism to gather explicit consent before collecting and using users' watch history

issues.title: Lack of Transparent Notice
issues.description: The system should provide clear and concise notice about the processing of personal data in accordance with Article 3 of the Personal Data Protection Bill, 2019.
issues.impact: Potential loss of user trust and possible legal repercussions
issues.remediation: Update the policy to include transparent notice about the processing of personal data

evidence_cited.citation: The Personal Data Protection Bill, 2019 (Bill No. 234 of 2019)
evidence_cited.content: Article 3: Personal data should be processed in a fair and reasonable manner, with transparent notice provided to the data subject.

evidence_cited.citation: The Personal Data Protection Bill, 2019 (Bill No. 234 of 2019)
evidence_cited.content: Article 7: Explicit consent from the data subject is required for the processing of sensitive personal data.
